data.name: Legends of Cumans
data.detailed_description:
Twenty years ago, the First Earth, home of the Elves, was attacked by the Immortal Lord Velomdor. From every Elf he killed, Velomdor created a creature known as a White Creature, with the goal of building an army strong enough to one day invade the Second Earth, home of the Cumans.
During the long war between the Elves and the Immortal Lord, three Elves forged an indestructible sword from a special diamond. This sword was the only weapon capable of defeating Velomdor, and because it was created by the Elven race, only an Elf could wield it. Velomdor eventually managed to steal the indestructible sword and hide it deep within the Dormin Mountains. From that moment on, the sword became known as the Secret Sword. After years of war, the Elven race was completely destroyed and transformed into White Creatures.
Only one Elf survived - Julian Baker.

You play as Julian Baker, the last surviving Elf who now lives among the Cumans, a race whose name is a mix between Cube and Humans, since everything in this world is cube-shaped, the perfect geometric form.

Chapter 1 – Road to the Kingdom

Under the command of the King of the Cumans, Julian must do everything he can to travel from the region of Reverdel to the Kingdom as quickly as possible. Solve bizarre and unusual puzzles, collect and purchase normal and strange items, explore underground areas, dark forests, and mysterious structures, and meet countless Cumans, each with their own strange stories, bizarre problems, and unique quests. Defeat the first boss, discover hidden places, earn achievements, collect special items, and find the first four Legends of Cumans, who fight for you against the White Creatures to help you safely reach the Dormin Mountains, where the Secret Sword lies.

Each Legend has its own stat card and unique abilities. Some fight fast, some slow; some lose more HP, while others consume less. To recover HP, some prefer to eat Woop Potato Chips Hot Chili, while others prefer Woop Potato Chips - Dormin Cheese. To obtain new Legends of Cumans, you’ll need to find, buy, trade, free, or earn them throughout your adventures.

Unique Battle System

Forget turn based combat.
In Legends of Cumans, every battle is time based, and each fight lasts a fixed number of seconds depending on which Legend is leading your formation.

For example:

Flint Grotovsky
Fights for 14 seconds
Loses 2 HP per enemy
Woop Potato Chips recover plus 1 HP

Victor Mandragor
Fights for 12 seconds
Loses 1 HP
Woop Potato Chips Hot Chili recover plus 1 HP

Rowan Dravik
Fights for 21 seconds
Loses 3 HP
Woop Potato Chips Dormin Cheese recover plus 2 HP

Gameplay Highlights:

  • Explore a hand-crafted, cube-based world
    Solve normal, bizarre, and logical puzzles
    Find and recruit multiple Legends with unique abilities
    Manage energy and recovery using Woop Potato Chips of different flavors
    Meet Cumans with their own stories, problems, and quests
    Experience a darkly comedic world filled with absurd dialogue and hidden lore
    Battle the mysterious White Creatures in time-based duels
    Defeat the first boss
    Uncover the truth behind the Secret Sword and the fate of the Elves

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL-compatible GPU with at least 512 MB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound - compatible
  • Additional Notes: 1280x720 display resolution or higher recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 1 GB VRAM or more
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound - compatible
  • Additional Notes: Runs smoothly on modern systems; no controller required

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mild pixelated nudity and humorous references to fictional drugs, alcohol, and cigarettes.
A short scene depicts characters protesting against clothing in a non-sexual and comedic context.
The game also features a fictional drug called “JOY,” as well as items such as beer, wine, and cigarettes used in puzzle-solving and character interactions.
None of these elements are shown realistically or intended to promote real substance use.
The provided screenshot illustrates the mentioned comedic protest scene for context.
